name: datestamp
title: Datestamp
description: A book-review theme set as a library book's inside cover: a buff date-due slip pasted on bottle-green buckram, black grotesque print, and an archive that is the slip's ruled grid with each review's date rubber-stamped in red, none quite straight.

tokens.--font-print: the printed type: body text, headings, the site title, the menu, the footer
tokens.--text-s: small print: the menu, labels, notes under archive titles, the footer, pagination
tokens.--text-l: the site title, standfirsts, the subscribe heading, small headings
tokens.--text-xl: headings inside a piece and the big date stamp on a piece's page
tokens.--text-xxl: the main title at the top of each page
tokens.--text-stamp: size of the date stamps in the archive
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of titles and headings
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital lines: menu, labels, the footer name
tokens.--tracking-stamp: letter spacing of the date stamps
tokens.--color-bg: the buff slip: the ground behind all reading text, also the e-mail field and the button's lettering
tokens.--color-text: printing ink: text, headings, links, and the subscribe button
tokens.--color-muted: secondary print: standfirsts, notes under archive titles, the line above the grid, the page count
tokens.--color-accent: date-stamp red: the stamped dates only
tokens.--color-ghost: the faint second strike of each stamp, and text selection
tokens.--color-rule: printed rules: the slip's frame, the grid, the menu dividers, tag labels, tables, quotations
tokens.--color-cloth: the bottle-green buckram behind the slip
tokens.--color-warp: the horizontal threads of the buckram weave
tokens.--color-weft: the vertical threads of the buckram weave
tokens.--color-on-cloth: lettering on the buckram: the footer
tokens.--color-pocket: the manila book pocket that holds the subscribe box
tokens.--color-glue: the band of paste showing through the top of the slip
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadow where the slip lifts off the cloth
tokens.--gutter: the strip of cloth left and right of the slip
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: under archive titles, inside the menu boxes, around lists nested in text, between footer lines
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between menu items, under titles, inside the form
tokens.--space-3: padding inside archive cells, gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and around the slip's head
tokens.--space-5: the large gaps: the foot of the slip, above the back link
tokens.--rule: thickness of hairline rules and underlines
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the double rules under the slip's head and over the grid
tokens.--tilt: how far a date stamp is knocked off true
